title: Plan Class Multiplier for Late-Provisioning Goodwill (Web Hosting Plans)
content:
The plan class multiplier of the late-provisioning goodwill follows the plan's tier, as shown on the hosting plan record: a Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8 plan takes 1.5, a Harborline Pro or Harborline Business plan takes 1.25, and any other plan takes one. The multiplier multiplies the late-provisioning goodwill figure.

| Plan tier on the hosting record | Plan class multiplier |
|---|---|
| Harborline Cloud 4 | 1.5 |
| Harborline Cloud 8 | 1.5 |
| Harborline Pro | 1.25 |
| Harborline Business | 1.25 |
| any other plan tier | 1 |

**Basis Q&A.** *A plan of a tier other than the four named above was activated late; what multiplier does its class carry?* One. *A figure of $8.12 on a Harborline Cloud 8 plan (hypothetical)?* It is multiplied by 1.5, giving $12.18.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts — goodwill for late provisioning of Web Hosting Plans*
